articles.text: ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Wǒ yě xiǎng dào Nánjīng qù kànkan.
MR. ANDERSON: I'd also like to go to Nánjīng to look around.
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Nǐ jìhua něitian qù?
COMRADE WÁNG: What day do you plan to go?
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Míngtian huòshi hòutian qù dōu kěyi. Shànghǎi lí Nánjīng yǒu duō yuǎn?
MR. ANDERSON: Tomorrow or the day after are both possible. How far is Shànghǎi from Nánjīng?
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Zuò huǒchē yào zǒu duōshao shíhou?
MR. ANDERSON: How long does it take to go by train?
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Dàgài yào zǒu sìge bàn xiǎoshí. Nǐ jìhua zài Nánjīng zhù jǐtiān?
COMRADE WÁNG: It probably takes four and a half hours. How many days do you plan to stay?
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Zhè shi wǒ dìyīcì dào Nánjīng qù. Nǐ shuō liǎngtiān gòu bu gòu?
MR. ANDERSON: This will be my first time going to Nánjīng. Would you say two days are enough?
COMRADE WÁNG: Two days are enough.
